mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(d.status = 'DRAFT'), 0) AS draft, COALESCE(SUM(d.status = 'PENDING_REVIEW'), 0) AS pending, COALESCE(SUM(d.status = 'APPROVED'), 0) AS approved, COALESCE(SUM(d.status = 'RETURNED'), 0) AS returned, COALESCE(SUM(d.status = 'WITHDRAWN'), 0) AS withdrawn, COALESCE(SUM(d.declared_amount), 0) AS total_amount FROM tax_declaration d WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT d.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM tax_declaration d WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY d.status ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT d.declaration_type_snapshot AS type_name, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(d.declared_amount), 0) AS amount FROM tax_declaration d WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY d.declaration_type_snapshot ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT t.taxpayer_type AS taxpayer_type, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(d.declared_amount), 0) AS amount FROM tax_declaration d JOIN taxpayer t ON t.id = d.taxpayer_id WHERE 1 = 1
GROUP BY t.taxpayer_type ORDER BY count DESC
